text:
Aria: Halyard dedicated cutover is tentatively set for Mon 06:00 PT. They've committed to 52k tokens/min. Need quick owners for quota confirm, autoscale tuning, shadow load, and a short enablement. Also capture the renewal risk ask (month-1 overruns).

Ben: I'll validate quota mapping with infra and escalate egress if needed. Last time their ISP throttled at ~30k rps.

Diego: I'll take autoscale. Proposed policy: min_nodes=3, step=+2, scale_up when cpu>68% or queue>200, scale_cooldown=50s.

ScaleBot: [08:05] policy-scan: 'balanced-step' simulated -> expected capacity at 52k in 10m, median scale latency 39s.

Maya: I'll run shadow load. Plan: mixed profile (short 75%, long 25%). Using `wrk` with orbs.lua variant.

Aria: SLA targets: P95 short <130ms, P95 long <320ms, error budget 0.2%. Also need a 30m enablement the day after cutover and a 6-week renewal touchpoint.

Ben: Confirmed infra ticket opened to bump egress to 60Gbps. ETA 36h. Sharing VPC test endpoints in DM.

Diego: Shadow script snippet:
```
wrk -t10 -c350 -d12m -s scripts/halyard_mix.lua https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
Expect ~3.2k rps for shorts at c350.

Maya: Shadow1 quick read: sustained 48.5k tokens/min, P95 short=120ms, P95 long=390ms (ouch), 5xx=0.04%. Autoscale added nodes twice, avg batch util 70%. Logs: https://logs.internal/halyard/4955556789/shadow1

Aria: Long-path latency is above target. Diego can you try `kv_prefetch` + smaller batch for long requests? Also add conditional config in runbook.

Diego: Will test: batch_max_tokens=3072 for long-paths, kv_prefetch=true. Also recommend scale-in cooldown=5m during golden hour to avoid oscillation.

ScaleBot: [08:47] canary-create: 3% traffic route for model 'redwood-halyard'. Monitors: latency, errors, cpu, queue. Auto-rollback threshold=0.5% 5xx over 5m.

FinanceBot: [08:50] forecast-note: to mitigate renewal risk, request uploaded: finance_template.xlsx. Need first-90-day usage estimate from CSM.

Maya: Shadow2 (kv_prefetch + batch change) in progress. Will post short results.

Ben: CSM flagged cost concern. They want a conservative burn forecast + low-cost fallback plan. Maya, can you capture sample token counts per endpoint to feed Finance?

Maya: Shadow2 results: long-path P95 dropped ~26% to 290ms, short P95 118ms, 5xx=0.03%. Autoscale stable. Shadow2 logs: https://logs.internal/halyard/4955556789/shadow2

Aria: Good. Owners: Ben=quota & infra, Diego=autoscale config & runbook, Maya=load tests & logs, Aria=program owner + renewal cadence, CSM=cost forecast.

Diego: I'll add conditional config snippet to the runbook and a quick toggles table for kv_prefetch and batch sizes.

Maya: For enablement, I'll record a 15m demo clip of routing + fallback to `redwood-lite` and attach the short survey (3 Qs + free text).

Ben: Reminder: if egress not raised by EOD, postpone cutover 48h. I'll confirm by 17:00 PT.

ScaleBot: [09:21] shadow-2: kv_prefetch enabled, expected long-path P95 improvement ~20-30%. Simulation complete.

Aria: Final asks before next check-in: Ben confirm egress by EOD, Diego post runbook snippet, Maya upload sample token breakdown for Finance, CSM produce forecast spreadsheet. We'll reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
